variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: individual horse companion portrait for Aleria.
Bildformat 2:3. Tales of Xillia/Frieren Anime Art Style. Markante, überzeichnete Gesichtszüge und Proportionen, starke Mimik, klare Anime-Lineart und sauberes Cel-Shading. Weiche, simple Anime-Texturen für Haut, Stoff, Holz, Stein und Hintergrund. Keine realistischen Texturen, kein Fotorealismus, keine malerische Darstellung.
References: Image 1 is the Rhyfel breed anatomy reference ONLY: use the central horse's robust cavalry build, broad chest, load-bearing back, strong legs, moderate fetlock feathering, comparatively elegant neck and expressive calm equine head. Do not copy the rider, armor, flag, heraldry, other horses, watercolor medium or composition. Image 2 is the actual Gwyvern heraldic symbol ONLY: white/ivory wyvern with gold wing membranes and mane on black, red border. Use a simplified small embroidered version of that same distinctive creature.
Subject: ONE adult Rhyfel stallion belonging to Sir Trevor Gwyvern. Clearly a powerful, practical medium-large riding horse, not a slender racing horse, not a giant draft horse. Natural equine anatomy and expression, four properly connected legs and four hooves, both ears, entire horse including hooves and tail visible. No human/rider.
Tack: conservative functional brown leather riding saddle, plain small burgundy saddle pad, one simple girth, ordinary bridle and loose reins, modest stirrups. ONE short small black cloth pennant hanging close to the rear saddle flap, showing the white-and-gold Gwyvern wyvern with a narrow red edge; the pennant is a small accent, no pole and no oversized heraldic display. Horse body and face dominate. No horse armor, ornate metalwork, chains, medals, decorative straps, saddlebags, packed cargo or repeated insignia.
Scene: peaceful grassy edge of a coastal stable yard near a harbor; a low simple stone wall and distant sea softly suggested with large quiet anime shapes. No busy architecture, people, other animals or scenery clutter. Soft clear daylight. Portrait 1024x1536, 2:3. Clean readable full-body three-quarter composition, ample margins around ears, hooves and tail. No text, labels, watermark, split panels or collage.
Individual design: A deep seal-brown stallion, almost black over the back, warm brown on the muzzle and flanks, black mane and tail. A tiny irregular white star on the forehead, otherwise dark legs and dark hooves. Compact powerful build, broad forehead, slightly Roman-profile nose, substantial muscular neck. A thick heavy black forelock falls unevenly to one side, short unbraided mane. Calm soft dark-brown eyes and relaxed ears, patiently surveying the viewer, an unflappable dependable companion. All four feet planted naturally, neck slightly lowered, quiet weight and presence. Horse facing diagonally left, head gently turned toward viewer. Keep the coat truly dark brown-black, not chestnut, gray or golden.
